trail.text: Route shows restart signatures and early CPU spikes — pulling time series to confirm the failure order.

causes.reasoning: Memory climbed 253M to 504M starting at 40s with CPU to 47% and route latency p95 doubling, plus restart-like logs; downstream travel/travel2 503s coincide with this resource pressure.
Error burst 0 to 0.55-0.98 at 40-80s with 29 Http 503 Service Unavailable when calling downstream route, no CPU/mem anomaly itself so victim of route.
15 Internal Server Errors wrapping travel-service failures; it only calls travel/travel2 so downstream victim.
16 Service Unavailable errors (0 baseline) identical to travel-service, sharing the same route-service dependency, so parallel victim.
Transient latency spike to 0.43s at 60s coincident with route/travel incident, called by travel2, no error logs so secondary victim.
